sections.Profile:
"Stripping Funny" is a billiards-themed electro-mechanical pinball machine released by the Spanish manufacturer Inder in 1974. The game accommodates a single player and features two flippers, five pop bumpers, two slingshots, two standup targets, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Inder
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Pool (Billiards), 1970s, Games
